sources.title: Quadrature Over a Pyramid or Cube of Integrands with a Singularity at a Vertex
sources.verifiedContent: Original publisher metadata and abstract; original full text access was restricted.
sources.use: Historical primary source for a vertex-directed change of variables. Our tetrahedral radial-face chart and Jacobian are derived explicitly, not attributed as Duffy's exact formula.

sources.authors: S. E. Mousavi and N. Sukumar
sources.title: Generalized Duffy transformation for integrating vertex singularities
sources.verifiedContent: Original open-access full text, introduction and section2 equations1a–1b, pages128–129.
sources.use: Transformation Jacobians and tensor-product Gauss integration; motivates explicit transformation and exponent accounting. We use beta1 and dyadic radial shells, not an optimized power map or their singular-kernel error claim.

limits: The saved specimen fields have strictly positive J and a finite near-corner layer, not a proved p/r^alpha singular kernel.
No cited paper establishes this specimen's force accuracy; structural moments and later fixed-vector comparisons must be checked separately.
The four- and five-point binary64 Gauss tables are inherited byte-identically from the accepted fixed-field protocol; no new dependency or quadrature-table generator is introduced.
